features.description: Cover the read-only curriculum preview lookup by exact program, level, modality, and campus identity.
acceptanceCriteria: The service requests a comparison using the four validated program identity dimensions.
A published reference produces a comparison tied to that reference.
No published reference produces NO_REFERENCE without counts or sample rows.
